entries.german: Notariatsinstrument des Johannes Pardeis de Kempnat, Klerikers der Regensburger Diözese: Urkunde über die von Peter Johannes de Capistrano, S. Franziskenordens, zu Nürnberg vom 21. Juli bis 10. entries.english: Notarial instrument of Johannes Pardeis de Kempnat, cleric of the Diocese of Regensburg: a record of the healings performed in Nuremberg by Peter Johannes de Capistrano of the Order of St Francis from 21 July to 10 August. It was drawn up before the notary Johann Pardeis von Kempnat at the request of the Nuremberg city council. The German entry lists the people reported healed, including Agnes, daughter of Knörlein von Abenberg; Anna Fischerin; Gertrud, wife of Ulrich Lang; Anna, wife of Heinrich Weiß von Lindenbach; Friedrich Reuscher; the unnamed father of the vicar of St Sebald; Anna, wife of Ulrich Hodler; Konrad Pair von Uttenhofen; Johannes von Scheinfeld; Agnes Liderin von Thundorf; Möstel von Diepersdorf; Sebald, son of Gerlach in the Irrergasse; Friedrich von Pölling; Katharina, daughter of Johann Türsen von Windischenhenpach; Johann Scherling, priest of the Regensburg diocese from Dietfurt; the son of Ulrich Payr von Herzogenaurach; Katharina Marckharttin von Aw; Matheus Lang von Bamberg; Martin Bader of Heilsbronn; Johannes Fistulator; Agnes Senfftin von Schwabach; Katharina Schupffin von Langenfeld; Kunigunde von Morstetten; and the many further individuals named in the source. It also lists the witnesses to the healings, including Nuremberg councillors, clergy, and other named persons.
